content: In conclusion, the bulk freight road transport sector in South Africa is characterized by a complex network of regional routes anchored by vital operational hubs at major seaports and inland industrial centers. The permanent shift in global maritime traffic around the Cape of Good Hope has fundamentally altered the volume and velocity of freight moving through the country, placing unprecedented demands on the logistics network [13] .
